items.title: Alex vs. Your ATS's Native AI: Should You Just Use What You Already Have?
items.summary: Your ATS's native AI is already paid for and installed. Alex interviews on the channel a candidate will answer, verifies who's on it, and hands back a scored result. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. BrightHire
items.summary: BrightHire is interview intelligence — it records and analyses the interviews your team runs. Alex runs the interviews itself, scores them and verifies who's on the call. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. SmartRecruiters
items.summary: SmartRecruiters is an ATS with the Winston agent layered in. Alex conducts interviews across channels, scores them, and writes results back into the ATS you already own. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. HireVue
items.summary: HireVue is an assessment platform that added interviewing. Alex is an AI recruiter that owns the whole process. A side-by-side on channels, cheat detection, ATS depth and compliance.

items.title: Alex vs. Tenzo
items.summary: Tenzo screens over voice and video. Alex runs the whole process — interviews over video, phone and WhatsApp, an integrity threshold you set per role, and write-back to 100+ ATS platforms. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Phenom
items.summary: Phenom is a talent-experience platform — career sites, CRM, internal mobility. Alex is an AI recruiter that conducts interviews, verifies candidates and writes results back to your ATS. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Metaview
items.summary: Metaview is an AI notetaker that captures the interviews your team runs. Alex is an AI recruiter that conducts them, scores them and verifies the candidate. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. HeyMilo
items.summary: HeyMilo runs the interview and hands candidates a self-schedule link. Alex owns the whole process — real calendar coordination, WhatsApp and SMS, 100+ ATS integrations, and SOC 2 Type II. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Paradox
items.summary: Paradox is a conversational assistant — text-to-apply, chat qualification, self-service booking. Alex conducts the interview itself, scores it and verifies the candidate. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Bullhorn
items.summary: Bullhorn is the staffing industry's system of record. Alex is an AI recruiter that runs the screening conversation and writes scored results back into it. Probably not an either/or — here's the side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Eightfold
items.summary: Eightfold is a talent-intelligence platform where interviewing is an add-on module. Alex is an AI recruiter running the hiring journey end to end — interviews, integrity checks and ATS write-back. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. ConverzAI
items.summary: ConverzAI is a voice virtual recruiter built to call candidates at volume. Alex runs video, phone and WhatsApp interviews with integrity scoring and 100+ ATS integrations. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Ribbon
items.summary: Ribbon is an AI interviewer for voice and phone screening. Alex runs the whole process — video, phone and WhatsApp, ID verification on top of behavioral signals, and SOC 2 Type II. A side-by-side.

items.title: Alex vs. Asendia
items.summary: Asendia is an AI recruiter built around the voice screen. Alex runs video, phone and WhatsApp, verifies identity rather than inferring it, and carries SOC 2 Type II. A side-by-side.
